answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 152200 Country: Pakistan Title: Prime Minister's Youth Business Loan Scheme Question: I want to ask about PM youth loan that this is legal for me or not? Let me describe this loan, in this loan Govt of Pakistan giving a up to Rs. 20 lacs for 8 years for youngsters for business on behalf of 6% fixed interest and also they will keep any property which would be equal to the amount , so I want to avail this loan but not for business for my house construction. My father has retired and we do not have any good source of income so in this case construct a house is too difficult if I can avail this loan so it can be very helpful for us and me can generate some revenue in sense of rent. So I want to know that this is legal for me or not? Answer ID: 152200 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1013/993/SD=10/1438) It is not lawful to take loan in the above mentioned case. The Hadith sternly warns against doing interest based dealing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
